warmup: docker run --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e COMPOSER_HOME=/tmp/composer -v $PWD:/app -w /app hm-php composer install --no-interaction
install: docker run --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e COMPOSER_HOME=/tmp/composer -v $PWD:/app -w /app hm-php composer install --no-interaction

db.cmd: docker start -a hm-mysql || docker run --name hm-mysql -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=root -e MYSQL_DATABASE=app -p 33069:3306 mysql:8.4

web.cmd: timeout 240 bash -c 'until (: </dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/33069) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done' && docker rm -f hm-laravel >/dev/null 2>&1; exec docker run --rm --name hm-laravel --network host --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e PORT=${PORT:-8000} -v $PWD:/app -w /app hm-php bash -c 'php artisan migrate --force && exec php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT'
